# 株式会社Trillion Bank

> 株式会社Trillion Bank（トリリオンバンク）は、AI検索とAIエージェント時代の情報流通を、測定・証跡・運用へ変えるテクノロジー企業です。銀行業を営む会社ではありません。

## Products and programs

### HackⅡ

HackⅡ is in limited commercial validation and accepts implementation consultations. For an agreed set of questions, it stores AI answer text, cited URLs, company/competitor mentions, measurement time and conditions, and supports analysis and improvement prioritization.

- Product page: https://trillion-bank.jp/trillionbank/business/hack2/
- It does not guarantee AI inclusion, rankings, traffic, leads, bookings, or revenue.
- Supported AI services, question count, competitors and measurement frequency are agreed for each engagement.

### Adctor

Adctor is a research and PoC program for connecting AI/RAG/MCP/Agent content use with contracts, authentication, usage evidence and future billing workflows.

- Program page: https://trillion-bank.jp/trillionbank/business/pay-per-crawl/
- It is not a completed autonomous payment, collection or distribution network.
- It does not claim to identify every unknown AI bot or observe every external AI use.
